[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Tutorial: Basic Controls[/color][/head]
This server uses a more detailed combat and interaction system (Hullrot mechanics) than standard Space Station 14. The keys below cover what new players need most. You can rebind any of them here:
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Melee Combat[/color][/head] Melee uses a detailed system with slashing, parrying and executions.
- [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="LeftClick"/][/color] performs a normal melee attack (slash). - [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="RightClick"/][/color] parries or blocks an incoming attack. Good timing gives you a major advantage. - [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="MiddleMouse"/][/color] performs a soft attack for interacting with fragile objects, such as breaking a window without a full swing.
For the full breakdown of parry timing, stamina, and executions, see the [color=#e8b04b]Melee Combat[/color] page under this Tutorial.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Looking Ahead / Peeking[/color][/head] Hold [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="LookUp"/][/color] and your camera slides toward the direction you are facing, letting you see [color=#e8b04b]further than normal[/color].
Use it to look around a corner or wall, spot a threat approaching from far away, or see your target before you shoot. If you want to check where you are aiming before firing, this key is a lifesaver.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Racking / Chambering Your Weapon[/color][/head] Most firearms here [color=#d9776c]do not chamber themselves automatically[/color]. Even with a magazine loaded, the gun will not fire if there is no round in the chamber.
To rack your weapon, press [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="ActivateItemInHand"/][/color] while holding it. This feeds a round into the chamber.
Keep in mind: - Rack the weapon once when you first pick it up. - After a magazine runs dry, load a fresh one and rack again. - Pump-action and manual weapons may need to be cycled after every shot.
You can also remove a chambered round by holding the weapon in one hand and clicking it with an empty hand while holding [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Alt + Left Click"/][/color].
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Wielding (Two Hands)[/color][/head] Many rifles, shotguns and heavy weapons [color=#d9776c]cannot be used properly one-handed[/color]. To wield a weapon, press [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Z"/][/color] while holding it.
Pressing [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Z"/][/color] again while wielded will rack and chamber the weapon.
Wielding improves accuracy a lot, and some weapons can only be fired while wielded. You need a free hand to wield.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Lying Down and Taking Cover[/color][/head] [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="R"/][/color] makes you lie down or stand back up.
While lying down, press [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Shift + R"/][/color] to hide under or behind certain objects. This helps you take cover and stay out of sight.
Lying down also makes you a smaller target and lets you use low cover more effectively.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Action Slots (Numpad)[/color][/head] You can trigger the abilities on the action bar (left side of your screen) with the [color=#e8b04b]Numpad[/color] keys. [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Hotbar1"/][/color] fires the first slot, and [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Hotbar0"/][/color] (Numpad 0) fires the last slot.
This is much faster than clicking your actions.
If your action slots seem to be missing, you may simply have too many actions and your hotbar has filled up, so the extras moved to another page. Use the [color=#e8b04b]1-9 keys along the top of your keyboard[/color] to switch action pages and find them. Drag and drop the slots to arrange them however you like.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Other Important Keys[/color][/head] - [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="SwapHands"/][/color] swaps your active hand, letting you quickly switch between your weapon and another item. - [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="ActivateItemInWorld"/][/color] uses or interacts with something in the world, such as doors, crates, and hatches. - [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Drop"/][/color] drops the item in your hand. - [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="ThrowItemInHand"/][/color] throws the item in your hand. - [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="ExamineEntity"/][/color] examines something, which is always useful for learning what it is and how it is used.
